subject: general
question: Pattadakal dance festival is organized in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pattadakallu** normally referred to as Pattadakal is a small village in Karnataka and the embodiment of an Indian architectural wonder. 
 
• To rejoice in the grandeur and tale of those temples, the government of Karnataka organizes the annual Pattadakal Dance pageant.
 
• **Each yr, in January **or February this dance festival is held in the village itself and is attended by way of humans from all over the globe.
 
• It might be a low-key three-day ritual and is scheduled to begin on 1st **January 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihu is the most famous folk dance in Assam.**
 
• Celebrated for 5 days commencing from the whole moon day of Phalguna (February/March), Yaoshang is the top-rated festival of Manipur. 
 
• A few folks and tribal dances in Jharkhand are **Jhumair, Mardana Jhumair, Janani Jhumair, Domkach, Lahasua, Jhumpa, Fagua, Paika, Chhau, Firkal, and Santali.**
 
• **The Hampi pageant,** celebrated in November, is one of the most critical galas in Karnataka celebrated on a grand stage.
